name: simple_sparse_array
title: Build a sparse array from a matrix of 1-based subscripts and a value vector.

origin.description: Build a sparse array from a matrix of 1-based subscripts and a value vector.
origin.details: Build a sparse array from a matrix of 1-based subscripts and a value vector.
origin.value: The same value R returns for this call.
origin.example:
.libPaths(c(path.expand("~/R/library"), .libPaths()))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(slam))

a <- simple_sparse_array(cbind(c(1, 2), c(1, 2)), c(1, 2), c(2, 2))
print(as.array(a))

translation.description: Build a sparse array from a matrix of 1-based subscripts and a value vector.
translation.details: Build a sparse array from a matrix of 1-based subscripts and a value vector.
translation.value: The same value R returns for this call.
translation.example:
from slam import simple_sparse_array
from slam._arrays import as_array
a = simple_sparse_array([[1, 1], [2, 2]], [1, 2], [2, 2])
print(as_array(a))
